title: Mit Singh Crosses the Yamuna into a Fatal Last Stand

blocks.text: Tara Singh had warned Mit Singh against crossing Yamuna with a smaller force, arguing that a lightly supported raid would invite disaster once word reached larger enemy centers. Mit Singh pressed on anyway, leading a mobile Sikh band across the river into Rohilla territory and spending several days gathering plunder around Meerut.

The warning proved true when Rohilla resistance hardened and troops from Lahore and Sirhind arrived to reinforce the pursuit. Their combined force attacked at sunrise with such force that the booty-laden Singhs were thrown into confusion, and many were cut down before they could form a proper defense.

Even in that reversal, Mit Singh kept fighting as a martyr rather than retreating in panic. The turning point came when his horse fell after being hit by a bullet, leaving one of his feet caught and making it clear that the brave raid had turned into a sacrificial last stand.
